hook: This feature looks useless, until it costs you

beats.say: In a simulated table of 40,000 ride requests, removing the city column drops the model's AUC by 0.169, yet alone it scores like noise.
Price alone scores 0.693, but price plus city reaches 0.860, within a whisker of the best possible 0.861.
In a pool of 196 columns, four useful features were invisible to univariate tests, so use a boosted model's loss-based importance instead.
